lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular spots are arranged in a repeating grid-like lattice across the flank, aligned with three primary horizontal carinae and numerous vertical bands.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of slightly elevated pixel intensity intersect with horizontal ridges to form anchor points where discrete, high-luminance circular blobs are positioned.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three prominent horizontal ridges run parallel across the mid-flank, defined by a distinct brightness gradient consisting of high-intensity upper edges and low-intensity shadowed lower edges.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Sparse distribution of low-contrast, high-luminance spots is visible on the surface of the first dorsal fin, though resolution is degraded by motion blur and water depth.

other_distinctive_markers: Multiple small, dark, elongated silhouettes representing commensal organisms are visible along the ventral surface and trailing the trailing edge of the pectoral fin.
